name_zh: 萨巴赫/科威特议会/石油：议会君主制与石油福利国家
name_en: Sabah/Kuwait Parliament/Oil: Parliamentary Monarchy & Oil Welfare State
description_zh: 科威特萨巴赫家族/阿卜杜拉·萨利姆/贾比尔/萨巴赫/纳瓦夫/1962 宪法/海湾最早议会/石油/主权财富基金/未来世代基金/福利/免费医疗/教育/住房/无税/外劳/海湾战争/伊拉克入侵/解放/政治稳定/继承/议会解散/选举/民主/君主制。核心模式：议会君主制石油福利 — 宪法/议会/君主/石油/福利/主权财富/外交/海湾合作/伊拉克/伊朗/沙特/美国/平衡。体现 M219 议会君主制/石油福利 — 以"宪法议会+石油福利+主权财富+君主立宪"四位一体，在海湾/伊拉克/伊朗/大国四重环境中构建海湾最稳定议会君主制。
description_en: Kuwait Sabah family/Abdullah Al-Salim/Jaber/Sabah/Nawaf/1962 Constitution/Gulf's first parliament/oil/SWF/Future Generations Fund/welfare/free healthcare/education/housing/tax-free/expatriates/Gulf War/Iraqi invasion/liberation/political stability/succession/parliament dissolution/elections/democracy/monarchy. Core model: Parliamentary Monarchy Oil Welfare — constitution/parliament/monarch/oil/welfare/SWF/diplomacy/GCC/Iraq/Iran/Saudi/US/balance. Exemplifies M219 Parliamentary Monarchy/Oil Welfare — quaternity of 'constitutional parliament + oil welfare + sovereign wealth + constitutional monarchy' building Gulf's most stable parliamentary monarchy amid quadruple Gulf/Iraq/Iran/great power environment.
reason_zh: 科威特非单纯石油君主国，而是"宪法议会+石油福利+主权财富"三位一体海湾民主样本。1962 宪法确立议会/君主分权，石油财富支撑全民福利/主权财富基金跨代，议会制衡君主/解散/选举常态化。M219 区隔于 M170 部落联邦(阿联酋)、M195 永久中立(卡塔尔)、M169 后石油转型(沙特)，核心在于"宪法议会即政治契约+石油福利即社会契约+主权财富即代际契约"的海湾议会君主制范式。
reason_en: Kuwait not mere oil monarchy but 'constitutional parliament + oil welfare + sovereign wealth' trinity Gulf democracy sample. 1962 Constitution established parliament/monarch separation of powers, oil wealth funds universal welfare/SWF intergenerational, parliament checks monarch/dissolution/elections normalized. M219 distinct from M170 Tribal Federalism (UAE), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Qatar), M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), core: 'constitutional parliament as political contract + oil welfare as social contract + sovereign wealth as intergenerational contract' Gulf parliamentary monarchy paradigm.

海湾外交与区域平衡：海合会/伊拉克/伊朗/沙特/美国/调解/人道/重建/投资/小国/杠杆/生存/外交/智慧
steps_en: 1962 Constitution & parliamentary system: Gulf's first written constitution/National Assembly/50 seats/elections/legislation/oversight/interpellation/no-confidence/monarch/PM/cabinet/power checks
Oil welfare universal contract: oil 90%+ exports/GDP per capita high/free healthcare/education/housing/subsidies/no income tax/citizens/expatriates/welfare = legitimacy
Sovereign wealth fund intergenerational contract: 1960 KIA/Future Generations Fund/General Reserve Fund/global assets/intergenerational savings/post-oil/transparency/governance
Parliamentary checks & political normalization: dissolution/elections/interpellation/no-confidence/opposition/women/Shia/tribes/urban/normalized/stability/Gulf democracy benchmark
